digest_markdown:
• [1] A supply chain attack on SolarWinds in 2019 and 2020 compromised the IT monitoring system Orion, which was used by over 30,000 organizations, allowing hackers to deliver backdoor malware in an Orion software update. [1]
• [2] A TanStack npm supply chain attack in May 2026 allowed attackers to copy about 170 private GitHub repositories, including CrowdSec's, after a former employee's account was compromised. [2]
• [1] An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking group called TeamPCP, which tainted hundreds of open-source programs with malware and stole developer accounts. [3]
• [2] A TanStack npm attack led to the copy of 170 private GitHub repositories, including CrowdSec's, with sensitive information such as email addresses, names, and investment context of users. [4]
• [3] The TeamPCP group released a Dune-themed self-spreading worm to automate the process of exploiting victims, breaching over a thousand companies. [3]
